question_text: How many distinct cameras produced at least one event between 09:00 and 10:00 UTC on 2025-12-08 (the morning keynote hour)?
answer_text: Eight distinct cameras produced at least one event between 09:00 and 10:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Community summaries note active cameras included DemoBooth_Intel (CAM_04), DemoBooth_NVIDIA (CAM_05), ExpoFloor_MainAisle (CAM_06), FoodCourt_North (CAM_07), and KeynoteHall_Stage (CAM_08).

retrieved_communities.summary: Cameras involved: DemoBooth_Intel (CAM_04), DemoBooth_NVIDIA (CAM_05), ExpoFloor_MainAisle (CAM_06), FoodCourt_North (CAM_07), KeynoteHall_Stage (CAM_08). Events are dominated by person movements (person_entry 206, person_exit 181, total 387) versus vehicle events (car_entry 29, car_exit 33). The dataset covers the UTC hour range 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-08T23:00:00Z with events from 2025-12-08T00:02:26Z to 2025-12-08T23:59:14Z; total events 449, peak head_count 500, average head_count (mean of means) ≈ 31.1974. Peak event count per hour is not provided in the supplied data.

Between 2025-12-08T01:00:41Z and 2025-12-08T01:59:48Z (hour 01:00–01:59 UTC) there were 39 events recorded across the monitored nodes (node_count: 40). Events were dominated by people: 23 person_entry and 11 person_exit (34 person events) versus 1 car_entry and 4 car_exit (5 vehicle events). Camera locations are not specified in the profile and peak_head_count is not provided; the peak hourly event count for the reported hour was 39.

Cameras CAM_01 covered Gate_MainEntrance and Platform_1 from 2025-12-01T01:00:00Z to 2025-12-08T12:00:00Z (events recorded between 2025-12-01T01:04:10Z and 2025-12-08T12:59:57Z). Total volume was 1,775 events: person activity dominated (788 person_entry and 773 person_exit = 1,561 person events) versus 112 car_entry and 102 car_exit. Average head count (mean-of-means) was 10.42 with a peak head count of 47.0; node_count is 1,802 and average events/hour ≈ 9.9 (1775 events over ~179 hours); peak per-hour event count is not specified in the provided profile.

No camera locations were specified. Events occurred between 2025-12-08T18:00:01Z and 2025-12-08T18:59:57Z (within the 18:00 UTC hour). Person movements dominated (person_entry 300, person_exit 299) versus vehicle movements (car_entry 83, car_exit 62), totaling 744 events in the hour. Peak head_count is not available; peak event count for the hour = 744 and node_count = 745.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN c.camera_id AS cid
  UNION
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN c.camera_id AS cid
}
RETURN count(DISTINCT cid) AS active_cameras
